subject: plotting detection/occupancy curves with confidence intervals?

messages.author: 48e53ec4949972f6
messages.subject: plotting detection/occupancy curves with confidence intervals?
parts:
Hello,

I am trying to figure out how to plot the probability of detection or probability of occupancy as a curve with 95% confidence intervals. See attached image. The Y-axis is not probability of detection or occupancy but it is the same idea. I cannot find code or help anywhere on how to do this. I have the beta estimates and standard errors from my best performing model and would like to use this to plot the data.

Any help is greatly appreciated.

Thank you!

messages.author: 02d195331194f5bd
messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] plotting detection/occupancy curves with confidence intervals?
parts:
Sorry for the short and not-overly-informative response, but basically you want to use the predict() function to predict your response (probability of detection or occupancy) across a range of new x values. Here's info on predict in general, and here's a bit on predictions in unmarked. Hopefully that can get you started down the correct path. 

Philip Shirk
